answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 43540 Country: India Title: Prayer at other masjid Question: I am residing in an area where the closest masjid is about half km which is of Barailavi and another one is about 1 km. The masjid of our belief is away by about 4 kms. Considering the situation, please advice where shall I offer prayer? At present, I am offering salah at home. Answer ID: 43540 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 123/102/H=1434) Instead of offering salah at home, you should offer it in the mosque of your aqidah. It is not difficult at a time when the facility of good transportation is available to travel to four km away and offer salah there with Jamah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
